title: Agent-provenance edges in explicit/agents.jsonl trigger edge rebuilds but are never loaded into the published manifest-mode graph
wanted_capability: The explicit/agents.jsonl sidecar lane should be either a full participant of the published graph (loaded by the manifest-mode explicit/observed union with the same registration exemption the signature fold grants the "agents" stem) or excluded from the rebuild signature entirely. Today routes.rs's signature fold admits the "agents" stem on every lane, so persist_agent_provenance_edges appends and nudges trigger rebuilds, but EdgeIndex::load_legacy_explicit_edges filters through sidecar_project_id_is_registered, which has no agents special-case (only the path-based sidecar_project_is_registered does), so the published graph may never contain those edges.
missing_primitive: a single registration/admission predicate shared by the rebuild signature fold and the manifest-mode explicit-lane loader
evidence: src/server/routes.rs persist_agent_provenance_edges writes explicit/agents.jsonl via append_explicit_edges and nudges the watcher
src/server/routes.rs sidecar_project_is_admitted (rebuild signature fold) admits the agents stem
crates/bbox-edge-index/src/edge_index.rs load_legacy_explicit_edges (manifest-mode path) filters explicit/observed lanes through sidecar_project_id_is_registered
crates/bbox-edge-sidecar/src/edge_sidecar.rs sidecar_project_id_is_registered has no agents exemption; sidecar_project_is_registered (path-based, legacy-missing path) does
notes: Re-traced at 15b91420: behavior unchanged. The legacy-missing loader (project_sidecar_edges) admits agents via the path-based predicate; only the manifest-mode explicit-lane loader drops it.
